invariant.rule: files_found = imported + skipped (redact counted within imported); every import/redact file has >=1 target; every entity has >=1 source; all links bidirectional

secret_scan.scope: all 212 memory-dir .md files (full corpus) + 183 session-data files (excluded, scanned for completeness)

executor_notes: sources[] entries are {path, sha256}; when writing Bedrock frontmatter emit {url: <path>, type: 'markdown', synced_at: <import date>, sha256: <sha256>} (see import-plan.md ambiguous case on the sources schema).
links[] are symmetrized: write each link on both entities using the template's structural field for that pair (e.g. topic.actors / actor 'Related Topics'), bare [[slug]] only.
Topic slugs are YYYY-MM-<category>-<key> with YYYY-MM = earliest contributing source date; category 'working-agreement' is a proposed extension.
For merge candidates, newest_source_date / files[].last_modified decide which fact wins; keep superseded statements as dated history bullets, never drop them.
Never write the owner's email into any URL; email field only.

The source corpus is LIVE (another session rewrote people-network-route-latency-lane-2026-10-02.md at 2026-10-03T06:22Z during planning; manifest regenerated after). Before importing, re-hash every source: if any sha256 differs, re-read that file and re-plan its targets; never import content whose hash does not match the manifest.

entities.title: Influence vs alignment axes
entities.summary: Modeling principle: rank measures INFLUENCE while per-category stance measures ALIGNMENT; keep them as separate axes so active opponents can rank on influence while the stance layer and optimizer filter friend/foe, and undervalued underdogs surface in a separate efficiency view.

entities.title: Two-hop stance decomposition
entities.summary: Decompose CU alignment into a stance hop (speaker toward target) and a valence hop (target toward credit unions); accuracy ceiling sits in the valence hop (0.689 vs stance 0.915), fixed by a curated per-target valence registry rather than more model spend.

entities.title: Concurrent-service overlap edge rule
entities.summary: Social-network construction rule: no person-person edge without actual concurrent service; career sequence is trajectory, not friendship; payroll-container co-tenure is a clique degree, not co-work.

entities.title: Exclude on contradiction, not ambiguity
entities.summary: Record-linkage rule: exclude a row only when its own evidence CONTRADICTS the attribution (e.g. its text names another organisation); missing or ambiguous information is flagged, never excluded.

entities.title: Single-look holdout discipline
entities.summary: A holdout or optimization 'look' can be spent once: pre-register the gate, never re-run a consumed look, and never spend a single-shot holdout on a known non-certifiable model.

entities.title: Zero-rank-delta verification
